spec.rationale: V178 improves4/5folds but loses4 defaults at top20%; alignment across expert/fold scores may affect pooled ranking. V163 only class-prior shift was exactly baseline. This tests empirical crossfitted slope+intercept, not theoretical prior correction. Positive monotone calibration alone cannot improve standalone within-fold KS; any change must arise from fusion or fold alignment.
